## ASD Essential Eight: Configure Microsoft Office macro settings

Measures Microsoft Office macro policy compliance using Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management (`DeviceTvmSecureConfigurationAssessment`), Microsoft Intune (`IntuneDeviceComplianceOrg`), and runtime macro execution and tampering telemetry (`DeviceEvents`, `DeviceProcessEvents`, `DeviceRegistryEvents`).

**ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model (November 2023) summary:**
- **ML1**: Macros disabled for users without a business requirement; macros from the internet blocked; antivirus scanning enabled; users cannot change macro settings.
- **ML2**: Macros only run from admin-controlled trusted locations or when digitally signed by trusted publishers; Win32 API calls from macros blocked; macro events centrally logged.
- **ML3**: Only vetted, digitally signed macros from trusted publishers are permitted with certificate revocation checks and locked publisher lists.

> **Disclaimer:** Independent community workbook. Not produced, endorsed or supported by ASD, ACSC or Microsoft. Refer to the [ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model](https://www.cyber.gov.au/resources-business-and-government/essential-cyber-security/essential-eight/essential-eight-maturity-model) and [Microsoft 365 Apps macro blocking documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-apps/security/internet-macros-blocked).

parameters.name: DeviceGroup
parameters.label: Device group
parameters.query:
DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| distinct GroupName
| order by GroupName asc

content.title: Microsoft Office macro posture KPI summary

content.query:
let devices = DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| where ('*' in ({DeviceGroup}) or GroupName in ({DeviceGroup}));
DeviceTvmSecureConfigurationAssessment
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where ConfigurationSubcategory has_any ('Office', 'Macro', 'ASR') or ConfigurationId in ('scid-2501', 'scid-2502', 'scid-2503', 'scid-2504', 'scid-2505', 'scid-2016')
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, IsApplicable, IsCompliant, ConfigurationCategory, ConfigurationSubcategory) by DeviceId, ConfigurationId
| where IsApplicable == true
| join kind=inner devices on DeviceId
| summarize CompliantDevices = dcountif(DeviceId, IsCompliant == true), NonCompliantDevices = dcountif(DeviceId, IsCompliant == false) by ConfigurationId, ConfigurationSubcategory, GroupName
| extend CompliancePct = round(100.0 * CompliantDevices / max_of(CompliantDevices + NonCompliantDevices, 1), 1)
| order by CompliancePct asc
content.title: Defender TVM Office macro configuration compliance by device group

content.query:
IntuneDeviceComplianceOrg
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, ComplianceState, OS, OSVersion) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| summarize Devices = dcount(DeviceId) by OS, ComplianceState
| order by Devices desc
content.title: Intune device compliance overview for policy enforcement

content.query:
let devices = DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| where ('*' in ({DeviceGroup}) or GroupName in ({DeviceGroup}));
DeviceEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where ActionType in ('AsrOfficeMacroWin32ApiCallsBlocked', 'AsrOfficeMacroWin32ApiCallsAudited', 'AsrOfficeChildProcessBlocked', 'AsrOfficeChildProcessAudited', 'AsrOfficeExecutableContentBlocked', 'AsrOfficeExecutableContentAudited')
| join kind=inner devices on DeviceId
| summarize Events = count(), Devices = dcount(DeviceId), SampleFiles = make_set(FileName, 5), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by ActionType, GroupName, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by Events desc
| take 100
content.title: Office macro ASR blocks and audits (Win32 API calls, child processes, executable content)

content.query:
let devices = DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| where ('*' in ({DeviceGroup}) or GroupName in ({DeviceGroup}));
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ('winword.exe', 'excel.exe', 'powerpnt.exe', 'msaccess.exe', 'visio.exe', 'mspub.exe')
| where FileName in~ ('cmd.exe', 'powershell.exe', 'pwsh.exe', 'wscript.exe', 'cscript.exe', 'mshta.exe', 'rundll32.exe', 'regsvr32.exe', 'certutil.exe', 'bitsadmin.exe')
| join kind=inner devices on DeviceId
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, GroupName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Suspicious child processes spawned by Microsoft Office applications
